text: unsearchable: Heb. there is no searching
Put not forth thyself: Heb. set not out thy glory
discover not a secret to another: Or, discover not the secret of another
fitly spoken: Heb. spoken upon his wheels
of a false gift: Heb. in a gift of falsehood
Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbors house: Or, let thy foot be seldom in thy neighbors house | weary of thee: Heb. full of thee
The North wind driveth away rain, so doeth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue: Or, The North wind bringeth forth rain, so doeth a backbiting tongue, an angry countenance
